simple.meaning: מִזְרָח (mizrâch) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “sunrise , i.e. the east.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 74 times across Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, and 12 more, beginning at Exodus 27:13. Its contexts include family line, wilderness, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִזְרָח (H4217).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מִזְרָח (mizrâch) / H4217 is traced through Exodus 27:13, Exodus 38:13, Numbers 2:3, Numbers 3:38 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H4217. mizrach מִזְרָח noun [masculine] place of sunrise, east — absolute ׳מ Josh 11:3 21 t.; construct מִזְרַח Num 21:10 19 t., with ה locative מִזְרָ֫חָה Exod 27:13 28t., construct מִזְרְחָה Deut 4:41 ; Josh 12:1 ; Judg 21:19 (not in Genesis Leviticus Samuel Ezekiel etc.); — 1 sunrise always of quarter of the heavens = east ׳מ (ה)שׁמשׁ Num 21:11 (P), Deut 4:41 , 47 ; Josh 1:15 ; 12:1 ; 13:5 (all D), 19:12 , 27 , 34 (all P), Judg 20:43 ; 21:19 ; 2Kin 10:33 ; Isa 41:25 ; 45:6 ; 59:19 , compare ׳מ לארץ שׁמשׁ Judg 11:18 ; ׳מִמִּז וְעַדמְֿבוֺאוֺ שׁמשׁ Psa 50:1 ; 113:3 ; Mal 1:11 ; more often 2 without שֶׁמֶשׁ : a. the east מִמַּעֲרָב֑ מ ׳כִּרְחֹק Psa 103:12 . b. ׳מִמּ from the east Isa 41:2 ; 43:5 (opposed to מִמַּעֲרָב ), 46:11 ; Dan 11:44 (+ מִצַּפוֺן ); וּמִיָּם מִצָּפוֺן וּמִמַּעֲרָב֑ ׳מִמּ Psa 107:3 . c. to or toward the place of sunrise, to the east, eastward: -1 מִוְרָ֫חָה Num 32:19 (P), Deut 3:17 , 27 , 1Chr 26:17 (+ לַנֶּ֫גְבָּה לַצָּפ֫וֺנָה, ), Neh 3:26 ; לַמִּזְרָ֫חָה 2Chr 31:14 ; (4) ׳אֶלהַֿמּ Dan 8:9 (+ אֶלהַֿצֶּבִ֑י אֶלהַֿנֶּגֶב, ); (5) רָךְ עַדמִֿזְ וּמִצָּפוֺן עָדיָֿם מִיָּם Amos 8:12 . d. (on) the east side of, construct יְרִיחוֺ מִזְרַה קְצֵה Josh 4:19 (P); also with לְ הַנָּ֑יְא לְמִזְרַח 1Chr 4:39 , ׳לְמ הַיַּרְדֵּן 6:63 ; with ׳מִמִּז מִן, Josh 11:3 (opposed to מִיָּם ) compare 17:10 (+ מצָּפוֺן ; both J E), also 16:6 (P). e. after a construct מ ׳עַלכָּֿלמְּֿנֵי לגלעד 1Chr 5:10 ; הַמּ ׳רְחוֺב 2Chr 29:4 ; הַמּ ׳שַׁעַר Neh 3:29 ; מ ׳אֶרֶץ Zech 8:7 (opposed to הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ מְבוֺא ארץ ).
